def transform(grid):
    left = [row[:4] for row in grid]
    right = [row[5:9] for row in grid]
    # Preserve left pattern unless the right pattern completes every row to
    # four foreground cells, as in demo 1; then overlay its 2s.
    if all(sum(a != 0 or b != 0 for a, b in zip(l, r)) == 4
           for l, r in zip(left, right)):
        return [[b if b else a for a, b in zip(l, r)]
                for l, r in zip(left, right)]
    return left
